label: No placebo
rationale: This is a nonrandomized longitudinal questionnaire study comparing patients who choose long-term mechanical ventilation with those who decline it. The arms are explicitly active comparator groups, and the record describes no inactive, sham, or placebo comparator.

evidence.quote: before and after the introduction of life sustaining ventilation support
with NIV or TIV affects the quality of life

title: Effects of Long Term Ventilation Support on the Quality of Life of ALS Patients and Their Families

rule.label: No placebo
rule.reason: All recorded arms have recognized non-placebo types and no placebo mention in arms/interventions. Inferred from saved data; sham controls count as no placebo.
